verdict.rationale: Airbyte ships its own AI features: an AI Assistant that prefills and configures Connector Builder fields, and Airbyte Agents/MCP that let assistants like Claude or Cursor reach data. The evidence frames these as AI-driven configuration of one sub-tool and data access, not as general natural-language control of the platform (connections, syncs, schedules). missing for 10: documented natural-language command interface for core platform operations, evidence the AI Assistant accepts free-form NL instructions, evidence the MCP server manages Airbyte resources rather than only querying data, hands-on corroboration

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: When starting a new connector, AI Assistant can automatically prefill and configure a number of fields and sections in the Airbyte Connector Builder
Connect MCP-capable agents like Claude, Cursor, VS Code, ChatGPT, and Codex to your data through Airbyte Agents.
Equip your agents to query, search, and act on your data in real-time
